rationale: After reaching a 0.88% favorable excursion (~$14.01), KLAR fully reversed that >1 ATR move, reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($14.11) and our $14.13 entry price, and is now pressing into a fresh maximum adverse excursion at $14.16/$14.17. This round-trip and reclaim of short-term moving average support demonstrates that the downside breakdown failed and buyers have regained control, warranting an immediate exit rather than waiting for the $14.25 stop to be hit.
